body.p: In the Election/Restriction Requirement mailed July 26, 2024, the Examiner sets forth the following species restrictions for each of two alleged group of species:
First Group of Species: Location of the Processor
Al: The processor is provided in the wearable sensor device body; and
B1: The processor is remote from the wearable sensor device body and
configured to receive the sensor signals from the at least one sensor via
wireless communications.
Second Group of Species: Decrease of Pressurization Measure after Exiting Bed
A2: Resetting the pressurization measure upon detecting the person has returned
to the support surface; and
B2: Decreasing the pressurization measure as a function of a period spent off the
support surface or during which the person has exited the support surface.

Applicant hereby elects to prosecute the alleged Species B 1 and B2 without traverse. Claims 10-11, 13-20, 22-23, and 25-27 read on elected Species B1 and B2. Claim 21 reads on non-elected Species A1, and Claims 12 and 24 read on non-elected Species A2; accordingly, Claims 12, 21, and 24 are withdrawn.
Applicant requests examination and allowance of all elected claims.
Applicants have made an earnest effort to place this case in condition for allowance in light of the remarks set forth above. Applicants respectfully request reconsideration of the pending claims.

Applicants believe there are no fees due at this time. However, the Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any fees necessary or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 50-6736 of Slayden Grubert Beard P.L.L.C.
If there are any matters concerning this Application that may be cleared up in a telephone conversation, please contact Applicant's attorney at 512-402-3567.
